promise: Make India a $5 trillion economy by financial year 2024-25
description: Announced in his 2019 Independence Day address and repeated through 2019, promising India would be a $5 trillion economy by 2024-25. India's nominal GDP was about $3.6 trillion in FY2023-24 and about $4.3 trillion in FY2024-25 — well short of $5 trillion at the target date (only surpassed ~$4 trillion territory in 2025).
evidence: IMF and government estimates put FY2024-25 GDP near $4.3T
2019 Independence Day speech set the $5T target

review.note: Official 2019 target is FY2024-25, which ends March 31, 2025, not 2024. August 15 quotation and dollar GDP outcomes still need contemporaneous speech and a consistent fiscal-year series.

promise: Payments will launch on X in 2024
description: Musk promised the X 'everything app' would launch payments, later saying they would come 'early next year' (Oct 2024). Deadlines were repeatedly missed; X obtained money-transmitter licenses in most US states and partnered with Visa, with X Money rolling out in limited beta in late 2025-2026, but the promised full payments launch was never delivered on schedule.
evidence: X Money only reached limited beta in some US states by late 2025

review.note: Visa partnership supported. A promise 'in 2024' conflicts with March 2025 due date; October 15 source/date, later revision and actual beta/full launch status are unverified. Partnership/licensing alone does not establish launch.

promise: We will make an announcement about the successor to Nintendo Switch within this fiscal year.
description: Nintendo publicly unveiled Nintendo Switch 2 on January 16, 2025, before the March 31 end of its fiscal year.
evidence: Nintendo's dated January 16, 2025 notice establishes the successor announcement.

review.note: Nintendo's January 16 primary announcement establishes the successor reveal, but the May 7 original commitment has not yet been directly sourced. Remove the additional June launch claim until supported.

promise: Target India becoming a USD 5 trillion economy by fiscal 2024-25
description: Sitharaman's July 5, 2019 Budget presented the USD 5 trillion economy ambition for fiscal 2024-25.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: a consistently defined fiscal-year nominal GDP and dollar conversion was not established; the original USD 4.0-4.3 trillion estimate is removed.

promise: OpenAI's o3 reasoning model will be released in early 2025
description: OpenAI released o3 and o4-mini on April 16, 2025, including API access.
evidence: o3 and o4-mini released to the API on April 16, 2025

review.note: Release on April 16, 2025 is supported. December announcement wording and attribution need original material; 'early 2025' is not necessarily a March 31 deadline. A delivered product does not validate a fabricated precision in its earlier schedule.

promise: Make NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1 available to robotics developers
description: NVIDIA announced Isaac GR00T N1 on March 18, 2025 as immediately available, with model resources for robotics developers.
evidence: NVIDIA's dated announcement states immediate availability.
